parameters.name: BizId
parameters.description:
The unique ID that identifies a verification task. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. For a single verification task, the system supports unlimited submissions until the verification is passed and the task is completed.

> Use a different BizId for each new verification task.

parameters.name: BizType
parameters.description: The business scenario identifier for the ID Verification service. Create one in the console first. For more information, see [Business settings](~~127885~~).

parameters.name: FaceImageUrl
parameters.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the front-facing facial photo.

parameters.name: IdCardBackImageUrl
parameters.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the national emblem side of the ID card.

parameters.name: IdCardFrontImageUrl
parameters.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL of the portrait side of the ID card.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The ID of the end user, such as the account ID of the end user.
